intro.text: One of the roseite aethers of Dhatri, an ancient being older than the Shattering, who aids the Ghostbloods through his aetherbound.

items.text: Silajana was keen to help the Ghostbloods keep Autonomy from taking Scadrial, but was unwilling simply to kill the Set's soldiers, and had his aetherbound offer them the chance to surrender first.
Like every aether, Silajana predates the Shattering, and the aethers' worshippers hold that they are older even than Adonalsium.
